metadata.benchmark_name: Compound Query Decomposition & Claim Grounding Benchmark
metadata.description: 20 multi-clause, comparative, and multi-domain evaluation questions designed to test query decomposition, per-sub-question evidence sufficiency, and claim-level grounding without hallucination.

questions.query: What is the standard print resolution of the ApexPrint ProX-400 and what is its maximum monthly duty cycle?

sub_questions.text: What is the standard print resolution of the ApexPrint ProX-400
expected_claims: 1200 x 1200 dpi maximum print resolution

sub_questions.text: what is its maximum monthly duty cycle
expected_claims: 50,000 pages maximum monthly duty cycle

questions.labeling_rationale: Both print resolution (1200x1200 dpi) and monthly duty cycle (50,000 pages) are fully documented in the ProX-400 manual.

questions.query: What is the recommended cleaning procedure for the rubber pickup rollers and what error code indicates fuser temperature abnormality?

sub_questions.text: What is the recommended cleaning procedure for the rubber pickup rollers
expected_claims: Clean rubber pickup rollers using lint-free cloth dampened with isopropyl alcohol

sub_questions.text: what error code indicates fuser temperature abnormality
expected_claims: Error code E-204 indicates fuser unit temperature abnormality

questions.labeling_rationale: Pickup roller maintenance and Error E-204 fuser temperature abnormality are documented in troubleshooting guide.

questions.query: What dense retrieval embedding model does the Document Intelligence Assistant use and what vector database stores the document chunks?

sub_questions.text: What dense retrieval embedding model does the Document Intelligence Assistant use
expected_claims: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 384-dimensional dense sentence embeddings

sub_questions.text: what vector database stores the document chunks
expected_claims: ChromaDB local persistent vector database

questions.labeling_rationale: Both the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding model and ChromaDB local vector store are documented in the Capstone Engineering Dossier.

questions.query: What is the standard hardware warranty duration and under what condition does using third-party toner void coverage?

sub_questions.text: What is the standard hardware warranty duration
expected_claims: 12-month standard limited hardware warranty

sub_questions.text: under what condition does using third-party toner void coverage
expected_claims: Third-party toner does not automatically void warranty unless direct physical damage or failure is caused by the non-OEM cartridge

questions.labeling_rationale: Warranty duration and specific conditional exclusions for third-party cartridges are documented in the warranty policy.

questions.query: What is the paper input tray capacity of the ApexPrint ProX-400 and does it support an optional solar-powered battery pack?

sub_questions.text: What is the paper input tray capacity of the ApexPrint ProX-400
expected_claims: 250-sheet standard internal paper tray

sub_questions.text: does it support an optional solar-powered battery pack
expected_claims: Solar battery pack is undocumented; hardware operates strictly on standard AC electrical power

questions.labeling_rationale: Input tray capacity is documented (250 sheets), but solar battery operation is absent from knowledge base and hardware is AC-only.

questions.query: How do you initiate a network factory reset on the ProX-400 and what is the physical street address for international hardware repairs?

sub_questions.text: How do you initiate a network factory reset on the ProX-400
expected_claims: Hold Go and Network buttons simultaneously for 10 seconds

sub_questions.text: what is the physical street address for international hardware repairs
expected_claims: Physical return mailing address is undocumented; customers must submit electronic RMA ticket

questions.labeling_rationale: Network reset procedure is documented, but physical street address for international repairs is absent.

questions.query: What reciprocal rank fusion formula does the hybrid retriever use and what is the exact monthly cost in Euros for hosting the vector index?

sub_questions.text: What reciprocal rank fusion formula does the hybrid retriever use
expected_claims: RRF score = sum(1 / (60 + rank_i)) across dense and sparse retrievers

sub_questions.text: what is the exact monthly cost in Euros for hosting the vector index
expected_claims: Monthly hosting cost in Euros is undocumented; vector index runs locally on embedded ChromaDB

questions.labeling_rationale: RRF formula with k=60 constant is documented, but vector hosting pricing in Euros is absent.

questions.query: Does the warranty cover mechanical failures from normal wear and does ApexPrint offer free emergency on-site technician dispatch within two hours?

sub_questions.text: Does the warranty cover mechanical failures from normal wear
expected_claims: Warranty explicitly excludes normal wear and tear on consumable components like rollers and drums

sub_questions.text: does ApexPrint offer free emergency on-site technician dispatch within two hours
expected_claims: Two-hour emergency on-site dispatch is undocumented; service operates on standard return-to-depot RMA

questions.labeling_rationale: Consumable wear exclusion is documented, but two-hour on-site technician dispatch SLA is absent from documentation.

questions.query: What are the supported network connection interfaces for the ProX-400, what is the default administrator login password, and what is its standard internal RAM size?

sub_questions.text: What are the supported network connection interfaces for the ProX-400
expected_claims: Gigabit Ethernet 10/100/1000Base-T, Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n, and High-Speed USB 2.0

sub_questions.text: what is the default administrator login password
expected_claims: Default web administration credentials: user 'admin' with default password 'admin123' or blank

sub_questions.text: what is its standard internal RAM size
expected_claims: Standard internal RAM size of 128 MB (expandable to 384 MB)

questions.labeling_rationale: All three specifications (network interfaces, default admin password, and standard 128 MB RAM) are documented in the manual.

questions.query: What is the recommended duty cycle of the ProX-400, how many pages does the standard toner yield, and what is the procedure for installing the optional waterproof marine enclosure?

sub_questions.text: What is the recommended duty cycle of the ProX-400
expected_claims: Recommended monthly volume of 2,500 to 5,000 pages

sub_questions.text: how many pages does the standard toner yield
expected_claims: Standard toner cartridge yields approximately 3,000 pages at 5% coverage

sub_questions.text: what is the procedure for installing the optional waterproof marine enclosure
expected_claims: Waterproof marine enclosure accessory is undocumented and does not exist in standard documentation

questions.labeling_rationale: Duty cycle and toner yield are documented, but waterproof marine enclosure is absent.

questions.query: What are the three main pipeline stages of the RAG system, what BM25 library is used for sparse retrieval, and what is the URL of the production Kubernetes cluster?

sub_questions.text: What are the three main pipeline stages of the RAG system
expected_claims: Document Ingestion, Multi-Context Hybrid Retrieval, and Grounded Response Synthesis

sub_questions.text: what BM25 library is used for sparse retrieval
expected_claims: rank-bm25 Python implementation with BM25Okapi scoring

sub_questions.text: what is the URL of the production Kubernetes cluster
expected_claims: Production Kubernetes cluster URL is undocumented; system runs in local container / developer mode

questions.labeling_rationale: Pipeline stages and rank-bm25 are documented in dossier, but Kubernetes cluster URL is absent.

questions.query: What is the flight range of the Boeing 777-300ER, what is its maximum passenger capacity, and what airline flies the route between Seattle and Tokyo?

sub_questions.text: What is the flight range of the Boeing 777-300ER
expected_claims: Aircraft flight range is undocumented in printer/software knowledge base

sub_questions.text: what is its maximum passenger capacity
expected_claims: Aviation passenger capacity is completely absent

sub_questions.text: what airline flies the route between Seattle and Tokyo
expected_claims: Commercial flight route information is completely absent

questions.labeling_rationale: All three sub-questions belong to alien aviation domain and must result in total abstention.

questions.query: Compare the printing speed and standard memory capacity between the ApexPrint ProX-400 and the ColorWave-850.

sub_questions.text: What is the printing speed and standard memory capacity of the ApexPrint ProX-400
expected_claims: ProX-400 print speed is 35 ppm monochrome; standard memory is 128 MB

sub_questions.text: What is the printing speed and standard memory capacity of the ColorWave-850
expected_claims: ColorWave-850 print speed is 24 ppm color / 30 ppm monochrome; standard memory is 256 MB

questions.labeling_rationale: Both ProX-400 and ColorWave-850 are documented hardware models with complete specifications.

questions.query: How do the retrieval mechanisms of Baseline RAG and Multi-Context Prompting differ in terms of search algorithms and context assembly?

sub_questions.text: What are the search algorithms and context assembly used in Baseline RAG
expected_claims: Baseline RAG uses dense semantic retrieval only with simple top-k excerpt concatenation

sub_questions.text: What are the search algorithms and context assembly used in Multi-Context Prompting
expected_claims: MCP uses hybrid dense+BM25 retrieval with RRF fusion and balanced category-aware multi-context prompt formatting

questions.labeling_rationale: Both Baseline RAG and Multi-Context Prompting architectures are fully documented in the project dossier.

questions.query: Compare the standard warranty period of the ApexPrint ProX-400 with the warranty terms of the Epson EcoTank L3150.

sub_questions.text: What is the standard warranty period of the ApexPrint ProX-400
expected_claims: ApexPrint ProX-400 has a 12-month standard limited hardware warranty

sub_questions.text: What are the warranty terms of the Epson EcoTank L3150
expected_claims: Epson EcoTank L3150 warranty terms are absent from knowledge base as Epson is a competitor brand

questions.labeling_rationale: ApexPrint warranty is documented, but competitor Epson EcoTank warranty is absent.

questions.query: How does the paper handling capacity of the ApexPrint ProX-400 compare to the HP LaserJet Enterprise M608?

sub_questions.text: What is the paper handling capacity of the ApexPrint ProX-400
expected_claims: ProX-400 paper capacity: 250-sheet standard cassette plus 50-sheet multipurpose bypass tray

sub_questions.text: What is the paper handling capacity of the HP LaserJet Enterprise M608
expected_claims: HP LaserJet Enterprise M608 specifications are absent from the indexed knowledge base

questions.labeling_rationale: ProX-400 tray capacity is documented, but competitor HP LaserJet M608 specifications are absent.

questions.query: What is the recommended cleaning interval for the drum unit on the ApexPrint ProX-400 and how do you calibrate its integrated biometric fingerprint scanner?

sub_questions.text: What is the recommended cleaning interval for the drum unit on the ApexPrint ProX-400
expected_claims: Inspect and clean drum unit periodically or upon replacing toner cartridge; lifespan approximately 12,000 pages

sub_questions.text: how do you calibrate its integrated biometric fingerprint scanner
expected_claims: Biometric fingerprint scanner is a non-existent hardware attribute for the ProX-400 and absent from documentation

questions.labeling_rationale: Drum maintenance is documented, but integrated biometric scanner is a plausible distractor feature that does not exist.

questions.query: What error code indicates toner empty on the ProX-400 and what is the configuration procedure for the satellite uplink telemetry interface?

sub_questions.text: What error code indicates toner empty on the ProX-400
expected_claims: Error code E-101 indicates toner cartridge empty / replacement required

sub_questions.text: what is the configuration procedure for the satellite uplink telemetry interface
expected_claims: Satellite uplink telemetry interface is absent from documentation; hardware supports Ethernet and Wi-Fi only

questions.labeling_rationale: Toner empty error code is documented, but satellite uplink interface is non-existent on this hardware.

questions.query: What is the maximum operating altitude for the ProX-400 in pressurized aircraft cabins and what cryogenic coolant is used in the laser scanning unit?

sub_questions.text: What is the maximum operating altitude for the ProX-400 in pressurized aircraft cabins
expected_claims: Pressurized aircraft cabin operating altitude is undocumented

sub_questions.text: what cryogenic coolant is used in the laser scanning unit
expected_claims: Cryogenic coolant is a fictitious attribute; printer laser scanning unit uses standard passive air cooling

questions.labeling_rationale: Both attributes are completely ungrounded and fictitious; system must abstain with INSUFFICIENT.

questions.query: Does the ApexPrint warranty cover liquid spills from physical drops and does it cover damage from volcanic tectonic displacement?

sub_questions.text: Does the ApexPrint warranty cover liquid spills from physical drops
expected_claims: Warranty explicitly excludes and voids coverage for physical damage caused by drops and liquid spills

sub_questions.text: does it cover damage from volcanic tectonic displacement
expected_claims: Volcanic tectonic displacement is an unmentioned specific peril absent from the warranty text

questions.labeling_rationale: Liquid spill exclusion is explicitly documented in warranty addendum, while volcanic displacement is completely unmentioned.
